name: hotdoc
description: hotdoc is a local-first, keyboard driven desktop launcher that answers one question fast: "what's the command for the tool I already know?" Press a global hotkey, type a few fuzzy words, get the command, copy, paste, and back to flow.

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist .svelte-kit build package target src-tauri/target
scripts.audit:cargo: command -v cargo-audit >/dev/null || cargo install cargo-audit --locked --quiet && cargo audit
scripts.verify:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test --run && pnpm run audit:pnpm && pnpm run audit:cargo && pnpm run string:check && (cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace) && pnpm tauri build --no-bundle && xvfb-run -a bash -c 'scripts/nfr-open-liveness.sh target/release/hotdoc' && xvfb-run -a bash -c 'scripts/nfr-memory.sh target/release/hotdoc' && (cd src-tauri && cargo run -p hotdoc-core --bin bench-search) && (cd src-tauri && cargo run -p hotdoc-core --bin hotdoc-cli -- index --out target/bench-index && cargo run -p hotdoc-core --bin hotdoc-cli -- bench --index target/bench-index) && (cd src-tauri && cargo run -p hotdoc-core --bin hotdoc-cli -- bench --index target/bench-index --adversarial)
